Title: Aggregate demand and income gaps
Learning outcome: Explain the remaining AD determinants and distinguish equilibrium from full-employment income.
Retrieve: Retrieve consumption and saving relationships from Lesson 3.
Teach and model: Use the first half for investment, the accelerator, government spending and net exports; use the second for inflationary and deflationary gaps.
Practise and apply: Classify changes in AD components and identify an income gap on a labelled income–expenditure diagram.
Exit check: Explain why equilibrium income need not equal full-employment income.
Follow-up: Draw and explain one inflationary gap and one deflationary gap.
